card.name: Binary error-correcting codes of length 17 and distance 6

task.name: Binary error-correcting codes of length 17 and distance 6
task.description: Construct the largest set of 17-bit words with pairwise Hamming distance at least 6, the extremal quantity A_2(17,6). Brouwer's table lists 258..340: the lower bound is Milshtein's 2019 nonlinear code, the upper bound comes from semidefinite programming. The 256-word linear reference is the [18,9,6] extended quadratic-residue code shortened by one coordinate; the seed has 32 words.
task.contract: construct() -> nonempty list of distinct integers in [0, 2**N). Each integer encodes one N-bit binary codeword, including leading zeros. Every pair must have Hamming distance at least MINIMUM_DISTANCE. Linear and nonlinear codes are allowed. Score: number of codewords, maximized.
